subject: Private maintenance: safety gates & mini-rollback lane — approval request
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, ops@mercantile.io, sre@acmehealth.com
Date: 2025-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private maintenance: safety gates & mini-rollback lane — approval request

Hi all,

TL;DR: Planning a narrowly-scoped patch window for private customers running the 1.3.x runtime in their VPCs. I need sign-off on the safety gates and the mini-rollback lane below so we can lock the maintenance calendar by EOD.

Proposed window:
- Date: Thu 2025-06-04
- Start: 02:00 UTC / 19:00 PT (customer local TBD per account)
- Duration: up to 3 hours, with hard abort if customer SLA impact >5%

Scope and risk envelope:
- Microhotpatch to runtime kernels (latency critical), non-breaking model artifacts.
- We will deploy a canary rollout (5% -> 20% -> 100%) with holdpoints after each stage.
- Version pinning: we must ensure any customer-pinned nodes are skipped; patch only applied to unpinned fleets.

Safety gates (proposed):
1) Canary metrics: p99 latency increase <= 15ms AND error rate delta < 0.5% over 5m baseline.
2) KV cache validation: no cache-miss spike > 12% across canary cohort.
3) Network failover: BGP/VRF paths validated in staging; no route flaps > 1 per 10m.
4) Customer holdpoint: a 60-minute manual holdpoint at 20% before full rollout.

Rollback lane (mini-rollback):
- If a gate fails at any stage, we run an automated unpin-and-revert to the prior runtime artifact within ~8 minutes using the control-plane rollback job.
- Network-level rollback: VIP reassign + route re-announcement script (see attached stub).

Ask: please review the gates above and reply with any blocking concerns by 14:00 PT today. If we have no objections, I will publish the final plan and schedule on the ops calendar and share the staging runbook.

Attachments: private-mini-rollback-lane-v1.pdf (diagram + scripts), staging-runbook-v2.md (draft)

Thanks,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, ops@mercantile.io
Date: 2025-05-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private maintenance: safety gates & mini-rollback lane — approval request

On Wed, May 28, 2025 at 09:12 AM Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai> wrote:
> TL;DR: Planning a narrowly-scoped patch window for private customers running the 1.3.x runtime in their VPCs. I need sign-off on the safety gates and the mini-rollback lane below so we can lock the maintenance calendar by EOD.
> 
> Proposed window: ...

Thanks Avery — high level looks good. A few technical clarifications before I can sign off on the KV/cache and rollback automation:

1) KV cache eviction strategy: during rollback we should avoid mass-ejecting caches that will amplify cold-starts. Can we do a staged TTL reset (per-pod) + lazy rebuild, or do we have to invalidate?
2) Pinning scope: confirm the control plane will skip nodes where customers have explicitly pinned 1.3.x. What is the detection logic (label-based, API query)? We need that in the runbook.
3) Canary sizing and routing: 5% may be too small to catch cross-availability-network bugs. Propose cohort composition be spread across AZs and include at least one region-edge node.
4) Fallback timing: you say ~8 minutes for revert — what's the critical path? Is it control-plane job queue latency or node-level drain time?

I can take the lead on the rollback orchestration code review once the runbook is up. Also suggest adding an automated health-check kill-switch tied to the streaming circuit-breaker (if we see kv/mem pressure spike > 70% for 3m).

Karthik
Sr. Staff Engineer — Serving Runtime

From: Platform Ops <ops@mercantile.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: sre@acmehealth.com
Date: 2025-05-28T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private maintenance: safety gates & mini-rollback lane — approval request

Avery / team,

Mercantile confirms we can accept the proposed window for customers listed under PRV-128/PRV-129, subject to the following constraints: 
- Add a 60-minute holdpoint at 20% (we agree), and a final 30-minute post-100% validation before marking completed.
- During rollback, we require an explicit network rollback step: VIP reassign + ARP refresh on our edge appliances. Please include the network runbook section and a preflight checklist for route announcements.
- We have a blackout for DB schema migrations between 01:30-03:30 UTC; ensure no dependent jobs run in that window.

Please share the full staging-runbook-v2.md (not just the summary) and the scripts for VIP reassign. We will run a dry-run from our side on Tue 2025-06-02 in staging and report back.

Regards,
Platform Ops — Mercantile Systems
ops@mercantile.io

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, ops@mercantile.io
Cc: sre@acmehealth.com
Date: 2025-05-28T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private maintenance: safety gates & mini-rollback lane — approval request

Thank you everyone — summarizing decisions and owners so we have a single source of truth: 

Decisions (agreed):
- Canary cadence: 5% (AZ-spread) -> 20% (AZ + edge) with a 60-minute manual holdpoint -> 100% -> 30-minute post-check.
- Safety gates: p99 delta, error rate, KV-miss threshold and network route stability as proposed — Karthik to add the circuit-breaker trigger (KV/mem pressure >70% for 3m).
- Rollback: automated control-plane unrevert (+VIP reassign script). Acceptable rollback window target: <12 minutes end-to-end.
- Customers with explicit version pins will be excluded; control plane will query node labels (pin=true) and skip those hosts. Monica, please validate label query coverage in the next 24h.

Owners & next steps:
- Runbook (full): Avery to publish staging-runbook-v2.md to the drive by 16:00 PT today.
- Rollback scripts & review: Karthik to lead code review (OPS-1224) — target Wed 2025-06-03.
- Network preflight & dry-run: Mercantile ops will run dry-run on Tue 2025-06-02 and provide results.
- Oncall during window: Monica Patel (lead), Karthik Iyer (secondary), Neha will be exec contact.

Attachments included: private-mini-rollback-lane-v1.pdf, staging-runbook-v2.md (full).

If there are no blockers, I will move to publish the calendar invite and the ops playbook. Thank you for quick turn here — please reply only if you have objections.

Neha Kapoor
Director, Deployment Reliability
Redwood Inference
